⚠️ Due to ongoing development and updates, errors and bugs may occur. ⚠️

Pour the batter from the winter street fish-shaped bread stall, fill it with red bean paste and whipped cream, and bake it until golden brown.

• Open the circular 8-hole mold and rotate it to make fish-shaped bread.
• Fulfill orders from waiting customers to unlock new flavors and equipment.
• Grow your small street food stall into a larger business by employing staff and implementing automation, expanding it into shopping centers and buildings.

You can play on both PC and mobile devices.

[November 27th Update · Friends and VIP Supporters]
• My Roblox friends visit my street food stall and premium cafe as customers.
• The top supporter overall and the top 1-3 supporters from last week will visit you as VIP guests using your Roblox avatar.
• If the sponsorship ranking changes, new rankers will visit, and previously received orders will continue as before.
